summary: Completed live Application Catalog regression: anonymous redirect, admin login, seeded catalog, admin creation with toast, normal-user category scoping, and API persistence/authorization all passed.

minor.issue: Reviewed auth implementation uses passlib pbkdf2_sha256 rather than the bcrypt ($2b$) format required by the provided auth playbook; confirm this is an intentional policy decision.
Legacy shared backend conftest imports missing pytest_asyncio, so that backend test path cannot run; equivalent isolated tests passed from /app/tests.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime submit button was not discoverable by its declared admin-form-submit-btn test ID; accessible button interaction worked as a fallback.

action_items: Confirm the password-hashing policy or migrate to the expected bcrypt $2b$ format if required by the auth contract.
Restore/install pytest-asyncio or remove the stale backend conftest dependency so backend regression tests run normally.
Ensure AppFormDialog's submit button forwards data-testid=admin-form-submit-btn in the served bundle.
critical_code_review_comments: The requested catalog/auth business flows are working end-to-end; no critical API or authorization defect was observed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% requested flows; 1 low-priority test-ID discovery issue

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one temporary API regression application; created one uniquely named UI regression application that remains in the demo catalog as test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin and John Doe flows passed against the public preview. John Doe saw 11 scoped apps across Security and Monitoring and no admin controls. Browser reported only aborted Cloudflare telemetry plus expected navigation-related auth/logout aborts; no console errors or failed core API responses. Recheck submit-button test ID and auth hash policy after changes.
rca of the issue: The initial catalog-count assertion raced the React Query load and was corrected with an explicit wait. The form's declared submit test ID was absent in the served DOM, while the accessible Add application button worked, indicating a bundle/component prop-forwarding or stale-runtime mismatch rather than a business-flow failure.
